title: The Gnostic John the Baptizer
author: G. R. S. Mead
description: G. R. S. Mead explores John the Baptist through Mandaean religious literature. The work offers a historical introduction to traditions that give John a distinctive role beyond the familiar Christian accounts.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/gnosticjohnbapti00mead).
